scenarios.contract: Native and custom render button Enter/Space; disabled exclusion; stable host.
Space toggles aria-pressed; canceled change and disabled refuse mutation.
Named checked/required controls, Space; disabled/readOnly refuse change.
Named group/options; arrows select, Space keyup, Enter does not select; disabled/readOnly.
RTL arrows, focusable disabled tab without selection, panel relationships; dynamic highlighted removal.
Space expand/collapse, controls/panel linkage, disabled native trigger skipped.
Label/description, required/custom errors, first invalid focus, caret and stable input identity.
Keyboard initial focus, modal trap, title/description, inner Escape restores inner trigger then outer trigger.
Input/listbox relations, active descendant, dynamic item removal, Escape; actual Gecko RTL caret.
Keyboard open, listbox/options, select via arrows/Enter, Escape restores trigger.
Polite/assertive live text, title/description relations, keyboard dismiss; DOM is not speech proof.
Named progressbar/meter range values and separator orientation; static semantics.

accounting.policy: Conservative full source registration denominator; no title-keyword exclusions. Literal loop/each domains retained. Dynamic expansions, generators, skip/todo/guards remain blockers, not fabricated expanded counts.
